breakdown.description: The chemical system is restricted to Ga-N, but the referenced stable-entry set is Mg-Ga-N.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states it will 'filter the stable entries to include only Ga and N' and 'generate a formation energy diagram for the Ga-N chemical system using the filtered stable entries.' This repeats the original error of restricting the chemical system to Ga-N rather than using the full Mg-Ga-N stable entries. The ground truth instead directs the agent to build the phase diagram directly from all stable entries (Mg-Ga-N) without any filtering, and to construct the FormationEnergyDiagram from the provided defect entries, valence-band maximum, and bulk entry.
